title: Missing persistent tests for delegated SQL calls and driver.Valuer
claim: Checked-in integration tests omit non-context DB/Tx/Stmt and most QueryRow delegations and do not test driver.Valuer parameter success or error behavior. The private woven reproducer passes, but the checked-in suite does not guard these risk paths against future regression.
repro_command: cd /Users/eliott.bouhana/go/src/github.com/DataDog/dd-iast-go && mkdir -p /tmp/ddiast-review/wt && rsync -a --exclude .git --exclude .omo ./ /tmp/ddiast-review/wt/sink-sql/ && cp .omo/review/evidence/sink-sql/review_sql_test.go /tmp/ddiast-review/wt/sink-sql/iast/database/sql/testapp/review_sql_test.go && cd /tmp/ddiast-review/wt/sink-sql/iast/database/sql/testapp && GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go tool orchestrion go test -timeout 10m -count=1 -run TestReviewSQL -v .
